### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 to 1024, 45):** Contains app icon/title on the left; utility icons (Cloud, Cart, Bell, Menu) and window controls (Minimize, Maximize, Close) on the right.
*   **Sidebar (0, 45 to 280, 920):** Vertical navigation pane. Divided into sections: "Data Recovery", "Advanced Features", "File Backup".
*   **Main Content Area (280, 45 to 1024, 920):** Light gray background.
    *   **Header:** "Select a location to search for lost data" at top.
    *   **Internal Drives Section:** Label "Internal drives (2)" followed by a grid of drive tiles. One tile ("Windows(C:)") is selected and highlighted with a blue border.
    *   **Specify Location Section:** Label "Specify a location" followed by a grid of location cards (Recycle Bin, Desktop, Select Folder).
    *   **Footer Bar (280, 840 to 1024, 920):** Contains help text "Unable to find your hard drive?" on the left and a primary CTA "Search for Lost Data" on the right.
*   **Overlay/Tooltip (645, 105 to 970, 430):** A blue "Solution" card floating over the main content, anchored near the header. It contains text, a step indicator, and a "Next" button.
*   **Windows Taskbar (0, 920 to 1024, 768):** Standard Windows 11 centered taskbar.

### 2. TEXT
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar:**
    *   `Data Recovery` (Section Header)
    *   `Hardware Disk`
    *   `SD Card`
    *   `More Recovery Tools`
    *   `Advanced Features` (Section Header)
    *   `File Repair`
    *   `Lost Partition Rescue`
    *   `File Backup` (Section Header)
    *   `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Area:**
    *   `Select a location to search for lost data`
    *   `Internal drives (2)`
    *   `Windows(C:)`
    *   `31.15 GB/149.45 GB`
    *   `Specify a location`
    *   `Recycle Bin`
    *   `Desktop`
    *   `Select Folder`
    *   `Unable to find your hard drive?`
    *   `Search for Lost Data`
*   **Overlay:**
    *   `Solution 1:`
    *   `Refresh drives.`
    *   `1/3`
    *   `Next`
*   **System Tray/Taskbar:** `6:13 PM`, `10/17/2026`, `Search`

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window Background: `#F0F2F5` (Light Gray) - ESTIMATED
    *   Sidebar Background: `#FFFFFF` (White) - ESTIMATED
    *   Overlay Background: `#1890FF` (Bright Blue) - ESTIMATED
    *   Taskbar Background: `#F3F3F3` (Light Gray/Transparent) - ESTIMATED
*   **Surfaces & Cards:**
    *   Selected Drive Tile Border: `#1890FF` (Blue) - ESTIMATED
    *   Unselected Tile Border: `#D9D9D9` (Light Gray) - ESTIMATED
    *   Button Primary Background: `#0055CC` (Darker Blue) - ESTIMATED
    *   Button Secondary/Overlay Next: `#FFFFFF` (White) - ESTIMATED
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Headings): `#000000` or `#1F1F1F` (Near Black) - ESTIMATED
    *   Secondary Text (Labels/Capacity): `#666666` or `#8C8C8C` (Dark Gray) - ESTIMATED
    *   Text on Blue Overlay: `#FFFFFF` (White) - ESTIMATED
    *   Text on Blue Button: `#1890FF` (Blue) - ESTIMATED
*   **Accents:**
    *   Progress Bar Fill: `#1890FF` (Blue) - ESTIMATED
    *   Progress Bar Track: `#E8E8E8` (Light Gray) - ESTIMATED
    *   Checkmark Circle: `#52C41A` (Green) - ESTIMATED

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** ~9-10px, Regular/Semibold, Segoe UI.
*   **Sidebar Items:** ~13px, Regular, Segoe UI.
*   **Sidebar Headers:** ~11px, Regular, Gray, Uppercase/Small Caps style.
*   **Main Heading ("Select a location..."):** ~20-22px, Semibold, Segoe UI.
*   **Section Labels ("Internal drives...", "Specify..."):** ~13-14px, Regular, Dark Gray.
*   **Tile Titles ("Windows(C:)", "Recycle Bin"):** ~14px, Regular/Medium, Segoe UI.
*   **Tile Meta ("31.15 GB..."):** ~11-12px, Regular, Gray.
*   **Button Text:** ~13px, Medium, Segoe UI.
*   **Overlay Text:** ~14px (Body), ~16px (Header), White.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Tile Size:** Approx 320px width x 110px height.
*   **Tile Padding:** ~16px internal padding.
*   **Icon Size (Tiles):** 48x48px.
*   **Gutter (Grid):** ~20-24px between tiles.
*   **Button Height:** ~36-40px (Standard touch target).
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Tiles: ~4-6px.
    *   Buttons: ~4-6px.
    *   Overlay: ~8px.
*   **Progress Bar Height:** ~4-6px.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List Item (Hardware Disk):** State = **Selected** (Blue left border indicator + Light blue background tint + Green checkmark badge).
*   **Sidebar List Item (SD Card, etc.):** State = **Normal**.
*   **Drive Tile (Windows C:):** State = **Selected/Focused** (Blue border, Radio button checked).
*   **Drive Tile (Ghosted one):** State = **Disabled/Inactive** (Grayed out, likely no media or system reserved).
*   **Location Cards (Recycle Bin, etc.):** State = **Normal**.
*   **Primary Button ("Search for Lost Data"):** State = **Normal** (Solid blue background).
*   **Secondary Button ("Next" in overlay):** State = **Normal** (White background, blue text).
*   **Close Icon (Overlay):** State = **Normal** ('X' icon).

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline/Filled hybrid (mostly filled shapes with simple details), consistent stroke weight (~1.5px - 2px).
*   **Grid:** 24x24 or 48x48 grid depending on location (Sidebar vs Tiles).
*   **Specifics:**
    *   **App Icon:** Blue square with graph symbol.
    *   **Hardware Disk:** Blue grid/window icon.
    *   **SD Card:** Gray SD card icon.
    *   **Tools:** Wrench/Screwdriver icon.
    *   **Repair:** Folder with tool icon.
    *   **Partition:** Globe/Network node icon.
    *   **Backup:** Circular arrow/history icon.
    *   **Tile Icons:** Large realistic/simplified representations (HDD, Recycle Bin, Monitor, Folder).
    *   **Overlay Character:** 3D rendered mascot (Robot/Astronaut).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Selection Required**. The user is at the first step of the wizard (Step 1: Select Location). No scanning is in progress.
*   **Overlay State:** **Active Onboarding/Tutorial**. A "Solution" tooltip is visible, suggesting an active guide or context-sensitive help feature is running (indicated by "1/3" step counter). The main window behind the overlay is dimmed (overlay mode).
